title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Cozmoslabs…
description: A stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Cozmoslabs TranslatePress plugin versions up to 3.3.8. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute in users' browsers. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.1.
